blocks.explanation:
\({}^{5}C_{3}\) ka matlab hai: 5 mukhtalif cheezon mein se 3 cheezein kitne tareeqon se chuni (select ki) ja sakti hain, jab order (tarteeb) ki koi ahmiyat nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(n = 5\) aur \(r = 3\). Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Plan: formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, bara factorial cancel karenge, phir multiply aur divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 5\), \(r = 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{5}C_{3}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\). Yeh formula asal mein permutation \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko \(r!\) se divide karna hai. Kyun? Kyunke har ek group ko \(r!\) tareeqon se tarteeb diya ja sakta hai, aur combination mein hum un sab tarteebon ko ek hi ginte hain.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[{}^{5}C_{3} = \dfrac{5!}{3!\,(5-3)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{5!}{3!\,2!}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(n = 5\), \(r = 3\), is liye \(n - r = 2\). Pehle saaf saaf values likh lena achhi aadat hai, is se ghalti ka imkaan kam ho jata hai.

\(3!\) cancel karein aur hisaab lagayein
\[= \dfrac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3!}{3! \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{5 \cdot 4}{2} = \dfrac{20}{2} = 10\]
Kyun: \(5! = 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1\) ko hum \(5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3!\) likh sakte hain. Neeche do factorials hain, \(3!\) aur \(2!\); bare wale (\(3!\)) tak hi upar ka factorial khol dein to woh foran cancel ho jata hai aur bari bari multiplication se bach jate hain.

Tasdeeq: Pascal ke rule se
\[{}^{4}C_{3} + {}^{4}C_{2} = 4 + 6\]
\[= 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pascal ka rule \({}^{n}C_{r} + {}^{n}C_{r-1} = {}^{n+1}C_{r}\) (Question 14 mein saabit kiya gaya hai) chhote combinations se wahi value deta hai, yani hamara jawab doosre raste se bhi sahi nikla.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{n}C_{r}\) aur \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko mix na karein; combination kabhi permutation se bara nahi hota. Aur jawab hamesha poora (whole) number hota hai; fraction aaye to cancel karne mein ghalti hai.

blocks.explanation:
\({}^{8}C_{5}\) ka matlab hai: 8 mukhtalif cheezon mein se 5 cheezein kitne tareeqon se chuni (select ki) ja sakti hain, jab order (tarteeb) ki koi ahmiyat nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(n = 8\) aur \(r = 5\). Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Plan: formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, bara factorial cancel karenge, phir multiply aur divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 8\), \(r = 5\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{8}C_{5}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\). Yeh formula asal mein permutation \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko \(r!\) se divide karna hai. Kyun? Kyunke har ek group ko \(r!\) tareeqon se tarteeb diya ja sakta hai, aur combination mein hum un sab tarteebon ko ek hi ginte hain.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,(8-5)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{8!}{5!\,3!}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(n = 8\), \(r = 5\), is liye \(n - r = 3\). Pehle saaf saaf values likh lena achhi aadat hai, is se ghalti ka imkaan kam ho jata hai.

\(5!\) cancel karein aur hisaab lagayein
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!}{5! \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{6} = 56\]
Kyun: \(8!\) ko \(5!\) tak khola: \(8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!\). Neeche wala \(5!\) upar wale \(5!\) se cancel ho gaya. Ab neeche \(3! = 6\) bacha jo upar wale 6 se cancel ho gaya, aur sirf \(8 \times 7 = 56\) reh gaya. Yeh shortcut yaad rakhein: upar \(r\) ya \(n-r\) factors gin kar likhein aur neeche chhota factorial rakhein.

Tasdeeq: Pascal ke rule se
\[{}^{7}C_{5} + {}^{7}C_{4} = 21 + 35\]
\[= 56 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pascal ka rule \({}^{n}C_{r} + {}^{n}C_{r-1} = {}^{n+1}C_{r}\) (Question 14 mein saabit kiya gaya hai) chhote combinations se wahi value deta hai, yani hamara jawab doosre raste se bhi sahi nikla.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{n}C_{r}\) aur \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko mix na karein; combination kabhi permutation se bara nahi hota. Aur jawab hamesha poora (whole) number hota hai; fraction aaye to cancel karne mein ghalti hai.

blocks.explanation:
\({}^{3}C_{3}\) ka matlab hai: 3 mukhtalif cheezon mein se 3 cheezein kitne tareeqon se chuni (select ki) ja sakti hain, jab order (tarteeb) ki koi ahmiyat nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(n = 3\) aur \(r = 3\). Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Plan: formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, bara factorial cancel karenge, phir multiply aur divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 3\), \(r = 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{3}C_{3}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\). Yeh formula asal mein permutation \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko \(r!\) se divide karna hai. Kyun? Kyunke har ek group ko \(r!\) tareeqon se tarteeb diya ja sakta hai, aur combination mein hum un sab tarteebon ko ek hi ginte hain.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[{}^{3}C_{3} = \dfrac{3!}{3!\,(3-3)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{3!}{3!\,0!}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(n = 3\), \(r = 3\), is liye \(n - r = 0\). Pehle saaf saaf values likh lena achhi aadat hai, is se ghalti ka imkaan kam ho jata hai. Yahan \((3-3)! = 0!\) ban raha hai; ghabrayein nahi, \(0!\) ki value maloom hai.

\(0! = 1\) istemal karein
\[= \dfrac{3!}{3! \cdot 1} = 1\]
Kyun: Definition ke mutabiq \(0! = 1\) hai (Section 7.2 mein is ki wajah batayi gayi thi). Yeh corollary \({}^{n}C_{n} = 1\) ki misaal hai: agar 3 cheezon mein se teeno hi chunni hon to sirf ek hi tareeqa hai, sab utha lo. Roz marra ki misaal: agar class mein sirf 3 students hon aur 3 ki team banani ho to team sirf ek hi ban sakti hai.

Tasdeeq: list bana kar
\(\{A, B, C\}\) mein se 3 cheezon ka sirf ek group hai, \(\{A, B, C\}\) khud: 1 group \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Jab saari cheezein hi leni hon to chunne ki koi gunjaish nahi bachti, is liye sirf ek tareeqa.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{n}C_{r}\) aur \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko mix na karein; combination kabhi permutation se bara nahi hota. Aur jawab hamesha poora (whole) number hota hai; fraction aaye to cancel karne mein ghalti hai.

Diya kya hai? \(n = 10\) aur \(r = 7\). Find kya karna hai? Is ki value.
Plan: formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, bara factorial cancel karenge, phir multiply aur divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 10\), \(r = 7\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{10}C_{7}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\). Yeh formula asal mein permutation \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ko \(r!\) se divide karna hai. Kyun? Kyunke har ek group ko \(r!\) tareeqon se tarteeb diya ja sakta hai, aur combination mein hum un sab tarteebon ko ek hi ginte hain.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[{}^{10}C_{7} = \dfrac{10!}{7!\,(10-7)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{10!}{7!\,3!}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(n = 10\), \(r = 7\), is liye \(n - r = 3\). Pehle saaf saaf values likh lena achhi aadat hai, is se ghalti ka imkaan kam ho jata hai.

\(7!\) cancel karein aur hisaab lagayein
\[= \dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7!}{7! \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{720}{6} = 120\]
Kyun: \(10!\) ko \(7!\) tak khol kar \(10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7!\) likha, \(7!\) cancel ho gaya, aur \(720 \div 6 = 120\). Ek aur nazariya: \({}^{10}C_{7} = {}^{10}C_{3}\), kyunke 10 mein se 7 cheezein lena aur 3 cheezein chhor dena bilkul ek hi baat hai. Is liye jab \(r\) bara ho to \(n - r\) wala chhota hisaab karein.

Tasdeeq: Pascal ke rule se
\[{}^{9}C_{7} + {}^{9}C_{6} = 36 + 84\]
\[= 120 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pascal ka rule \({}^{n}C_{r} + {}^{n}C_{r-1} = {}^{n+1}C_{r}\) (Question 14 mein saabit kiya gaya hai) chhote combinations se wahi value deta hai, yani hamara jawab doosre raste se bhi sahi nikla.
